problem: Admin 核心漏斗 was not a valid funnel: stage 2 「开始测试」bound user_events.eventName='strategy_start' — an event that is NEVER written to user_events (home only calls legacy analytics.track('strategy_start'); analytics_logs is empty). Result: 开始测试=0 while 完成问卷=6 → non-monotonic, untrustworthy. Additionally: (a) stages counted RAW EVENTS via .count() (not users); (b) funnel/KPI/trend used server-local startOfDay() while AI metrics used startOfBeijingDay() — inconsistent time boundary despite declared businessTimezone; (c) stage 6 used client payment_success instead of the server payment authority (orders.status='paid'); (d) zero-denominator transitions rendered '0%' / '100%流失'.

changes.STAGE2_AUTHORITY: user_events.questionnaire_start (the real start signal; emitted at questionnaire onLoad). strategy_start is NOT added and NOT bound anywhere — no fabrication.
changes.STAGES_1_5: user_events { home_view, questionnaire_start, questionnaire_complete, report_success, payment_view } within the Beijing-day window
changes.STAGE6_AUTHORITY: orders where status='paid' (aggregate by openid, paidAt >= Beijing-day start) — server-authoritative; client payment_success is NOT the authority
changes.COUNT_UNIT: COUNT(DISTINCT openid) for ALL stages via aggregate().match().group({_id:'$openid'}).count('n').end(); raw event .count() removed
changes.TIMEZONE: entire dashboard (funnel + KPI + trend) uses startOfBeijingDay(ts) — Asia/Shanghai; server-local startOfDay() removed; trend buckets via beijingDayKey() (UTC-based, no local getHours/getDate)
changes.CONVERSION: conversion = cur/prev, dropoff = 1 - conversion; prev=0 → both null; alias array emits '' (UI --) — never '100%流失'
changes.INTEGRITY: monotonic invariant per stage; violation → integrity.valid=false + violations[]; counts NEVER clamped or faked; UI shows 数据口径异常 warning
changes.API_SHAPE: funnel: { scope:'today', timezone:'Asia/Shanghai', countUnit:'unique_users', stages:{home,start,complete,report,paymentView,paid}, integrity:{valid,violations} } + backward-compat aliases funnelStages[] (6-stage array), funnelIntegrity, funnelViolations
changes.CLIENT: dashboard.js consumes funnelStages (alias) + adds funnelCountUnitNote/funnelTimezone/funnelWarn/paymentNeutral; dashboard.wxml adds integrity warning, suppresses empty rate, and shows neutral note 「当前路径暂无付款入口」 when paymentView=0
changes.PAYMENT_NEUTRAL: legacy 6Q path has NO payment step → stages 5/6 legitimately 0; no fabricated conversion, no payment page built in this task

rollbackPlan: git revert <this-commit>; funnel is read-only aggregation — no data was mutated; no index added or removed.
